steps.description: If the fibula is from the right leg, tick the "Right side leg" checkbox.

sub_operations.description: Record whether the harvested fibula comes from the right leg so the fibula axis is oriented correctly.

ui_parameter_binding.ui_text: (tick if fibula is the one from the right leg)

properties.text: (tick if fibula is the one from the right leg)

sub_operations.question: Is the fibula graft taken from the right leg?

choice_info.question: Is the fibula graft taken from the right leg?

ui_guidance.title: Fibula graft side
ui_guidance.instruction: Tick the "Right side leg" checkbox if the fibula graft is taken from the right leg.

steps.description: In the "Select mandibular segmentation" section, choose the mandibular segmentation.

sub_operations.description: Select the segmentation node that contains the mandible.
sub_operations.question: Which segmentation contains the mandible?

ui_guidance.title: Select mandibular segmentation
ui_guidance.instruction: In "Select mandibular segmentation", choose the segmentation that contains the mandible.

steps.description: In the "Select fibula segmentation" section, choose the fibula segmentation.

sub_operations.description: Select the segmentation node that contains the fibula.
sub_operations.question: Which segmentation contains the fibula?

ui_guidance.title: Select fibula segmentation
ui_guidance.instruction: In "Select fibula segmentation", choose the segmentation that contains the fibula.

steps.description: In the "Current Scalar Volume" option, choose the Mandible Volume.

sub_operations.description: Select the current scalar volume (the mandible CT) used as background and for model generation.
sub_operations.question: Which scalar volume should be used as the current volume (e.g. the Mandible Volume)?

choice_info.question: Which scalar volume should be used as the current volume (e.g. the Mandible Volume)?

ui_guidance.title: Select current scalar volume
ui_guidance.instruction: In "Current Scalar Volume", choose the Mandible Volume.

steps.description: Click "Create bone models from segmentations" button.

sub_operations.description: Create the mandible and fibula bone models from the selected segmentations.

ui_guidance.title: Create bone models
ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Create bone models from segmentations" to build the mandible and fibula models.

steps.description: Change the layout to "Conventional".

sub_operations.description: Switch the application layout to the built-in Conventional (four-up) layout.

ui_guidance.title: Switch to Conventional layout
ui_guidance.instruction: Change the layout to "Conventional".

operation_descriptions: Switch the application layout to the built-in Conventional (four-up) layout.

steps.description: For the R (red) slice view, toggle ON "slice visibility in 3D view": render the red 2D slice plane inside the 3D view (the slice controller's eye/visibility button that shows the slice in 3D). This is a per-slice 3D-display toggle on the slice node.

sub_operations.description: Turn on 3D display of the Red slice plane so it is rendered inside the 3D view.

ui_guidance.title: Show red slice in 3D view
ui_guidance.instruction: For the red slice view, toggle on "slice visibility in 3D view" to render the red slice plane in the 3D view.

operation_descriptions: Turn on 3D display of the Red slice plane so it is rendered inside the 3D view.

steps.description: For the R (red) view, toggle on "FOV, Spacing match 2D" (adjusts slice resolution to match the 2D viewport pixel spacing).

sub_operations.description: Enable the Red slice view's FOV/spacing-match-2D option so slice resolution matches the 2D viewport.

ui_guidance.title: Match red slice FOV to 2D spacing
ui_guidance.instruction: For the red view, toggle on "FOV, Spacing match 2D".

operation_descriptions: Enable the Red slice view's FOV/spacing-match-2D option so slice resolution matches the 2D viewport.

steps.description: In the toolbar, turn on "slice intersection visibility". In the slice intersection interaction options, turn on "set interaction", then enable both "Translate" and "Rotate".

sub_operations.description: Show slice intersections in the views and enable their interactive translation and rotation.

ui_guidance.title: Enable slice intersection interaction
ui_guidance.instruction: Turn on "slice intersection visibility" in the toolbar, then in the slice intersection options turn on "set interaction" and enable both "Translate" and "Rotate".

operation_descriptions: Show slice intersections in the views and enable their interactive translation and rotation.

steps.description: Manually adjust the slice intersection position by translate and rotate of the cross lines in each view.

sub_operations.description: Manually translate and rotate the slice intersection cross lines in each view to position them.

ui_guidance.title: Adjust slice intersections
ui_guidance.instruction: Rotate and zoom the 3D view to see the slice intersection lines clearly, then drag the cross lines to translate and rotate them into the desired position in the views.

steps.description: Click the "Add mandibular curve" button.

sub_operations.description: Create the mandible curve markups node and enter place mode so the user can draw it.

ui_guidance.title: Add mandibular curve
ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Add mandibular curve" to create the mandibular curve.

steps.description: Configure the display settings of the mandibular curve created by the "Add Mandibular Curve" button. Specifically, in the "Markups" module, under the "Advanced" collapsible section, select "3D View 1" and "Red" in the "View" combo box.

sub_operations.description: Restrict the mandible curve's display to 3D View 1 and the Red slice view (Markups module, Advanced section).

ui_guidance.title: Set curve display views
ui_guidance.instruction: In the Markups module, under "Advanced", set the view for the mandibular curve to "3D View 1" and "Red".

operation_descriptions: Restrict the mandible curve's display to 3D View 1 and the Red slice view (Markups module, Advanced section).

steps.description: Manually click and draw on the "Red" view to create a curve along the mandible.

sub_operations.description: Draw the mandible curve by clicking along the mandible in the Red slice view.
sub_operations.placement_instructions: In the Red slice view, click along the mandibular bone to place control points of the mandible curve, following the mandible from one end to the other.

steps.placement_instructions: In the Red slice view, click along the mandibular bone to place control points of the mandible curve, following the mandible from one end to the other.

ui_guidance.title: Draw mandibular curve
ui_guidance.instruction: In the Red view, click along the mandible to draw the curve.

steps.description: Change the layout to "BoneReconstructionPlanner".

sub_operations.description: Switch the application layout to the extension's BoneReconstructionPlanner layout.

ui_guidance.title: Switch to BoneReconstructionPlanner layout
ui_guidance.instruction: Change the layout to "BoneReconstructionPlanner".

operation_descriptions: Switch the application layout to the extension's BoneReconstructionPlanner layout.

steps.description: For the R (red) slice view, toggle OFF "slice visibility in 3D view": stop rendering the red 2D slice plane inside the 3D view (the same per-slice 3D-display toggle as step 7, set off).

sub_operations.description: Turn off 3D display of the Red slice plane so it is no longer rendered in the 3D view.

ui_guidance.title: Hide red slice from 3D view
ui_guidance.instruction: For the red slice view, toggle off "slice visibility in 3D view".

operation_descriptions: Turn off 3D display of the Red slice plane so it is no longer rendered in the 3D view.

steps.description: Manually set how many cut planes you want.

sub_operations.description: Obtain the number of mandibular cut planes the user wants to create.
sub_operations.question: How many mandibular cut planes do you want?

choice_info.question: How many mandibular cut planes do you want?

ui_guidance.title: Number of mandibular cut planes
ui_guidance.instruction: Enter how many mandibular cut planes you want to create.

steps.description: Click "Add cut plane" button.

sub_operations.description: Create a new mandibular cut plane markups node and enter place mode.

controller.prompt: Repeat the Add cut plane click and the placement of one mandibular cut plane once for every cut plane requested.

ui_guidance.title: Add mandibular cut plane
ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Add cut plane" to create this mandibular cut plane.

steps.description: Place one mandibular cut plane using the extension's Add cut plane workflow. If the user requested N cut planes, repeat the Add cut plane + place plane interaction N times.

sub_operations.description: Place one mandibular cut plane in the views using the plane node created by the Add cut plane button.
sub_operations.placement_instructions: Place this plane, then click Done.

steps.placement_instructions: Place this plane, then click Done.

controller.prompt: Repeat the Add cut plane click and the placement of one mandibular cut plane once for every cut plane requested.

ui_guidance.title: Place mandibular cut plane
ui_guidance.instruction: Move and rotate this cut plane into position in the view.

steps.description: Click "Add fibula line" button.

sub_operations.description: Create the fibula line markups node and enter place mode.

ui_guidance.title: Add fibula line
ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Add fibula line" to create the fibula line.

steps.description: Draw a line over the fibula in "3D View 2", starting with the first point distally and the last point proximally.

sub_operations.description: Draw the fibula line over the fibula in 3D View 2, distal point first and proximal point last.
sub_operations.placement_instructions: In 3D View 2, click the first control point of the fibula line at the distal end of the fibula and the second control point at the proximal end.

steps.placement_instructions: In 3D View 2, click the first control point of the fibula line at the distal end of the fibula and the second control point at the proximal end.

ui_guidance.title: Draw fibula line
ui_guidance.instruction: In 3D View 2, click along the fibula to draw the line, starting with the first point distally and finishing proximally.

steps.description: Click "Reset field of view" button in the R (red) slice view.

sub_operations.description: Reset the Red slice view field of view so the content is re-fitted.

ui_guidance.title: Reset red slice field of view
ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Reset field of view" in the red slice view.

operation_descriptions: Reset the Red slice view field of view so the content is re-fitted.

steps.description: Click "Center fibula line using fibula model" button to align the line with the anatomical axis of the fibula.

sub_operations.description: Center and align the fibula line along the fibula model's anatomical axis.

ui_guidance.title: Center fibula line on fibula model
ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Center fibula line using fibula model" to align the line with the anatomical axis of the fibula.

steps.description: Tick the "Automatic mandibular planes positioning for maximum bones contact area" checkbox.

sub_operations.description: Enable automatic mandibular plane positioning for maximum bone contact area.

ui_parameter_binding.ui_text: Automatic mandibular planes positioning for maximum bones contact area

properties.text: Automatic mandibular planes positioning for maximum bones contact area

ui_guidance.instruction: Tick "Automatic mandibular planes positioning for maximum bones contact area".

steps.description: Tick the "Make all mandible planes rotate together" checkbox.

properties.text: Make all mandible planes rotate together

ui_guidance.instruction: Tick "Make all mandible planes rotate together".

steps.description: Enter the desired value in "Initial space (mm)".

ui_guidance.instruction: Enter the desired between space in millimetres.

steps.description: Click "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible" to generate the reconstruction and create the fibula cut planes.

sub_operations.description: Generate the fibula cut planes from the fibula line, cut out the fibula bone pieces and transform them into the mandible.

ui_guidance.instruction: Click "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible" to create the fibula cut planes and the reconstruction.

steps.description: Tick the "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible" checkbox.

sub_operations.description: Enable the check state of the generate/update button so the reconstruction updates when mandible planes move.

ui_guidance.title: Update fibula planes automatically
ui_guidance.instruction: Tick "Update fibula planes over fibula line; update fibula bone pieces and transform them to mandible".

steps.description: In the BoneReconstructionPlanner module, in the "Mandible planes" row, toggle on the eye-icon tool button to show the mandibular cut planes.

sub_operations.description: Show the mandibular cut planes by toggling on the eye-icon tool button in the Mandible planes row.

ui_guidance.title: Show mandible cut planes
ui_guidance.instruction: In the "Mandible planes" row, click the eye icon to show the mandibular cut planes.

ui_guidance.instruction: In the same "Mandible planes" row, click the axes icon to show the plane interaction handles.

steps.description: Manually adjust the mandibular cut planes in the mandible 3D view by dragging the visible plane interaction handles.

sub_operations.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the mandibular cut planes in the 3D view by dragging their visible interaction handles.

steps.placement_instructions: Manually adjust the mandibular cut planes in the 3D view by dragging their visible interaction handles.

ui_guidance.instruction: In the mandible 3D view, drag the visible plane handles to move and rotate the mandibular cut planes into the desired position.

steps.description: In the "Mandible planes" row, toggle off the eye-icon tool button to hide the mandibular cut planes.

ui_guidance.instruction: In the "Mandible planes" row, click the eye icon again to hide the mandibular cut planes.
